title: "Course Dashboard"

```{=html}
<script src="[https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2)"></script>

<div class="global-progress-banner relative-box" id="progress-tile">
  <div id="progress-content">
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
      <div>
        <h2 style="margin-bottom: 2px; font-weight: 800; color: white;">Your Progress</h2>
        <div id="gp-subtext" style="opacity:0.85;font-size:0.95rem; color: white;">Loading…</div>
      </div>
      <div id="auth-status"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mt-3">
      <div class="progress" style="height:22px; flex-grow: 1; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">
        <div id="global-progress-bar" class="progress-bar" role="progressbar" style="width:0%;background-color:#a8d5a2;color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:900;border-radius:50px;"></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:900;opacity:0.9; line-height: 1; color: white;" id="gp-percent-badge">0%</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Login Button Overlay -->
  <div id="login-overlay" class="centered-overlay-btn" style="display:none;">
     <button onclick="sbLogin()" class="btn btn-lg" style="background:white; color:#1a4d1a; border:none; border-radius:50px; font-weight:800; padding:12px 40px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">
        🐙 LOGIN WITH GITHUB
     </button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- LEADERBOARD KACHEL -->
<div id="leaderboard-section" class="global-progress-banner relative-box" style="margin-top: 2rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a4d1a 0%, #2d7a2d 100%); min-height: 150px;">
  <div id="leaderboard-content">
     <h3 style="color:white; font-weight:800; margin-bottom:1.5rem;">🏆 Class Leaderboard</h3>
     <div id="leaderboard-list" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;"></div>
     <div id="leaderboard-expand-container" style="text-align: center; margin-top: 15px; display: none;">
        <button onclick="toggleLeaderboard()" id="btn-expand" class="btn btn-sm" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: white; border: 1px solid white; border-radius: 50px; padding: 5px 20px;">SHOW ALL</button>
     </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Nickname Button Overlay -->
  <div id="nickname-overlay-btn" class="centered-overlay-btn" style="display:none;">
     <button onclick="showNicknameModal()" class="btn btn-lg" style="background:#a8d5a2; color:#1a4d1a; border:none; border-radius:50px; font-weight:800; padding:12px 40px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">
        🥇 CHOOSE NICKNAME
     </button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Nickname Modal -->
<div id="nickname-modal" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); z-index:10000; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:white; padding:40px; border-radius:20px; text-align:center; max-width:450px; width:90%;">
    <h2 style="color:#1a4d1a; font-weight:800;">Almost there!</h2>
    <p style="color:#555; margin-bottom:25px;">Pick a nickname to join the leaderboard.</p>
    <input type="text" id="nickname-input" placeholder="Your Nickname" maxlength="15" 
           style="width:100%; padding:15px; border-radius:50px; border:2px solid #eee; margin-bottom:20px; font-size:1.1rem; text-align:center;">
    <button onclick="saveNickname()" class="btn btn-lg w-100" style="background:#1a4d1a; color:white; border-radius:50px; font-weight:800; padding:12px;">
      SAVE & START
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<h3 style="color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1.2rem;margin-top:2rem;">Course Content</h3>
<div class="grid" id="week-cards-grid" style="align-items: stretch;"></div>

<script>
const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://hpyezixseggwnrpepbhx.supabase.co](https://hpyezixseggwnrpepbhx.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImhweWV6aXhzZWdnd25ycGVwYmh4Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NzY4MTUzMDgsImV4cCI6MjA5MjM5MTMwOH0.HGcrv7-I07yFES2qBRhXf1j3UCbfMb8PwlWkQjY6NYs';

let sbClient;
let _initialized = false;
let _isRendering = false;
let allLeaderboardData = [];
let isLeaderboardExpanded = false;

const WEEKS = [
  { n:1, title:"Week 1: Basic Data Structures", topics:"Syntax · Variables · Vectors · Matrices · Lists · Dataframes", href:"1_datentypen.html", chunkCount:28, quizIds:["w1_q_vectors","w1_q_matrices","w1_q_lists","w1_q_dataframes"] },
  { n:2, title:"Week 2: Datatypes", topics:"Factors · Discrete vs. Continuous · Type Coercion", locked:true }
];

async function initSupabase() {
  if (typeof supabase === 'undefined') return setTimeout(initSupabase, 100);
  if (!_initialized) {
    sbClient = supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY);
    _initialized = true;
    sbClient.auth.onAuthStateChange(() => render());
  }
  render();
}

initSupabase();

async function render() {
  if (_isRendering) return;
  _isRendering = true;

  try {
    const sessionRes = await sbClient.auth.getSession();
    const user = sessionRes.data.session?.user || null;

    const progContent = document.getElementById('progress-content');
    const loginOverlay = document.getElementById('login-overlay');
    const leadContent = document.getElementById('leaderboard-content');
    const nickOverlayBtn = document.getElementById('nickname-overlay-btn');
    const cardsGrid = document.getElementById('week-cards-grid');
    const leadSection = document.getElementById('leaderboard-section');

    let dbData = null;

    if (!user) {
      progContent.classList.add('tile-locked');
      loginOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
      cardsGrid.classList.add('auth-locked-cards');
      leadSection.classList.add('tile-locked');
      nickOverlayBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
      progContent.classList.remove('tile-locked');
      loginOverlay.style.display = 'none';
      cardsGrid.classList.remove('auth-locked-cards');

      const { data: profile } = await sbClient.from('profiles').select('nickname').eq('id', user.id).maybeSingle();
      
      if (!profile || !profile.nickname) {
        leadContent.classList.add('tile-locked');
        nickOverlayBtn.style.display = 'flex';
        leadSection.classList.remove('tile-locked');
      } else {
        leadContent.classList.remove('tile-locked');
        nickOverlayBtn.style.display = 'none';
        leadSection.classList.remove('tile-locked');
        loadLeaderboard();
      }

      const { data: rows } = await sbClient.from('progress').select('key, value').eq('id', user.id);
      if (rows) dbData = rows.reduce((acc, r) => { acc[r.key] = (r.value === 'true'); return acc; }, {});
    }

    updateAuthUI(user);
    renderWeekCards(dbData);
    updateGlobalUI(dbData);

  } finally {
    _isRendering = false;
  }
}

function renderWeekCards(dbData) {
  const grid = document.getElementById('week-cards-grid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  WEEKS.forEach(week => {
    const p = calculateWeekProgress(week, dbData);
    const col = document.createElement('div');
    col.className = 'g-col-12 g-col-sm-6 g-col-md-4';
    const isLocked = !!week.locked;
    const card = document.createElement(isLocked ? 'div' : 'a');
    card.className = 'week-card p-3' + (isLocked ? ' opacity-50' : '');
    if (!isLocked && week.href) card.href = week.href;
    const pct = p ? p.pct : 0;
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="week-card-title">${week.title}</div>
      <div class="week-card-topics">${week.topics}</div>
      <div class="week-card-status">${statusLabel(p, isLocked)}</div>
      ${p ? `<div class="week-card-progress-bar-bg mt-2"><div class="week-card-progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><div style="font-size:0.73rem;color:#6c757d;margin-top:4px;">${pct}% complete</div>` : ''}
    `;
    grid.appendChild(col);
  });
}

function updateGlobalUI(dbData) {
  let total = 0, done = 0, completedW = 0;
  WEEKS.filter(w => !w.locked && w.chunkCount).forEach(w => {
    const p = calculateWeekProgress(w, dbData);
    if (p) { total += p.total; done += p.done; if(p.pct === 100) completedW++; }
  });
  const gPct = total > 0 ? Math.round((done / total) * 100) : 0;
  document.getElementById('global-progress-bar').style.width = gPct + '%';
  document.getElementById('gp-percent-badge').innerText = gPct + '%';
  document.getElementById('gp-subtext').innerText = `${completedW} weeks completed`;
}

async function loadLeaderboard() {
  const { data, error } = await sbClient.from('leaderboard').select('*');
  if (!error && data) {
    allLeaderboardData = data;
    renderLeaderboard();
  }
}

function renderLeaderboard() {
  const container = document.getElementById('leaderboard-list');
  const displayData = isLeaderboardExpanded ? allLeaderboardData : allLeaderboardData.slice(0, 5);
  document.getElementById('leaderboard-expand-container').style.display = allLeaderboardData.length > 5 ? 'block' : 'none';

  container.innerHTML = displayData.map((entry, index) => {
    const icons = ["🥇", "🥈", "🥉"];
    const rank = index < 3 ? icons[index] : `${index + 1}.`;
    return `
      <div class="leaderboard-row" style="color: white; margin-bottom: 10px;">
        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.9rem;">
          <span style="font-weight: 700;">${rank} ${entry.nickname}</span>
          <span>${entry.percent}%</span>
        </div>
        <div class="progress" style="height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 10px;">
          <div class="progress-bar" style="width: ${entry.percent}%; background-color: #a8d5a2;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function toggleLeaderboard() {
  isLeaderboardExpanded = !isLeaderboardExpanded;
  renderLeaderboard();
  document.getElementById('btn-expand').innerText = isLeaderboardExpanded ? "SHOW LESS" : "SHOW ALL";
}

function showNicknameModal() { document.getElementById('nickname-modal').style.display = 'flex'; }

async function saveNickname() {
  const name = document.getElementById('nickname-input').value.trim();
  if (name.length < 3) return alert("Name too short!");
  const user = (await sbClient.auth.getUser()).data.user;
  const { error } = await sbClient.from('profiles').upsert({ id: user.id, nickname: name });
  if (error) alert("Error or name taken!");
  else { document.getElementById('nickname-modal').style.display = 'none'; render(); }
}

function calculateWeekProgress(week, dbData) {
  if (!week.chunkCount) return null;
  const total = week.chunkCount + (week.quizIds?.length || 0);
  let done = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i <= week.chunkCount; i++) if (dbData?.[`chunk_python_w${week.n}_c${i}`]) done++;
  week.quizIds?.forEach(qid => { if (dbData?.[`quiz_python_w${week.n}_${qid}`]) done++; });
  return { done, total, pct: Math.round((done / total) * 100) };
}

function statusLabel(p, locked) {
  if (locked) return '🔒 Locked';
  if (!p || p.done === 0) return '⬜ Not started';
  return p.pct === 100 ? '✅ Completed' : `🔄 ${p.done}/${p.total} done`;
}

function updateAuthUI(user) {
  const status = document.getElementById('auth-status');
  if (user) {
    status.innerHTML = `<button onclick="sbLogout()" class="btn btn-sm" style="background:white; color:#1a4d1a; border-radius:50px; font-weight:800; padding:5px 15px;">LOGOUT</button>`;
  } else { status.innerHTML = ''; }
}

async function sbLogin() { 
  await sbClient.auth.signInWithOAuth({ 
    provider: 'github', 
    options: { redirectTo: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname } 
  }); 
}

async function sbLogout() { 
  await sbClient.auth.signOut(); 
  sessionStorage.removeItem('sb-session'); 
  window.location.reload(); 
}
</script>
```
